title: SPINDEP: Spin-Dependent Exotic Interaction Analysis Framework
description: A Python framework for comparing matter and antimatter coupling-constant bounds on spin-dependent exotic interactions, classified by the Dobrescu–Mocioiu potentials (V1–V16). It discovers and matches matter/antimatter constraint datasets across lepton-lepton, lepton-nucleon and nucleon-nucleon sectors, interpolates them onto a common interaction-range grid, and computes an asymmetry parameter and a sensitivity ratio together with chi-squared diagnostics. For one-sided exclusion limits these quantities measure relative experimental sensitivity, not CPT violation. Developed for an M.Sc. thesis in Physics at the University of Ibadan.
